purpose: Language-pair-specific SRS topic availability. Picker support controls which user-facing topic chips are enabled; hidden overlay support means rows can exist in data but the topic is not yet a visible product choice.

support_states.picker_supported_topics: Visible and enabled in the current topic picker for this pair.
support_states.hidden_overlay_topics: Runtime topic rows may exist, but the topic remains hidden until coverage/provenance/product review is strong enough.
support_states.planned_source_required_topics: Canonical topic id exists, but this pair still needs safe source coverage or reviewed overlay work before product support.
support_states.future_register_topics: Canonical register id exists, but register preferences are not exposed in the current topic picker.
support_states.not_applicable_topics: Canonical id is intentionally out of scope for this pair.

en-ja.notes: en-ja has product-safe reviewed topic coverage across the current canonical topic palette; register preferences remain hidden.

en-es.notes: en-es exposes the rich strict-MVP picker set. Anime/manga/pop-culture remains hidden despite reviewed rows; register preferences remain hidden.

en-de.notes: en-de keeps the current extension-supported picker set; supplied product-owned seed lists now provide hidden overlay coverage for several follow-up topic families while review/promotion remains pending.
